/* ─── Google Fonts ─── */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&family=DM+Mono:wght@400&display=swap');

/* ─── Root tokens ─── */
:root {
  --accent:    #c0392b;
  --accent2:   #e74c3c;
  --ink:       #1a1a2e;
  --muted:     #6b7280;
  --surface:   #f9f6f1;
  --card-bg:   #ffffff;
  --border:    #e5e0d8;
  --tag-bg:    #fef3f2;
  --tag-color: #9b2335;
  --radius:    10px;
  --shadow:    0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.07);
}

/* ─── Typography ─── */
.hero-name, .section-title, .card-title {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   HERO BAND
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-band {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 55%, #0f3460 100%);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 4rem 3rem 3.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3rem;
}
.hero-band::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -60px; right: -60px;
  width: 280px; height: 280px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(192,57,43,.35) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hero-band::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -80px; left: 30%;
  width: 200px; height: 200px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(231,76,60,.18) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hero-avatar {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 120px; height: 120px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #922b21);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 2.8rem;
  color: #fff;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(192,57,43,.4), 0 0 0 8px rgba(192,57,43,.15);
}
.hero-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.hero-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .72rem;

  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent2);
  background: rgba(231,76,60,.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(231,76,60,.35);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}
.hero-name {
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.9rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 0 0 .6rem;
}
.hero-tagline {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  font-weight: 300;
  margin: 0 0 1.6rem;
}
.hero-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .6rem; }
.hero-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;

  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: .82rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 6px;

}
.hero-link.primary {
  background: var(--accent); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--accent);
}
.hero-link.primary:hover { background: #a93226; transform: translateY(-1px); }
.hero-link.ghost {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
}
.hero-link.ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); transform: translateY(-1px); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION TITLE
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.section-title {
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin: 0 0 1.2rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .6rem;
}
.section-title::after {
  content: '';
  flex: 1;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--accent), transparent);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   BIO PANEL
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.bio-panel {
  background: var(--card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 2rem 2.2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: .93rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.75;
}
.bio-panel p { margin: 0 0 .9rem; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════

══════════════════════════════════════ */
.timeline { position: relative; margin-bottom: 3rem; }
.timeline::before {

}

}

  margin-top: 2px;
  z-index: 1;
}
.tl-body {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 1.1rem 1.4rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);

}
.tl-body:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.10); }
.tl-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .5rem;
  margin-bottom: .4rem;
}
.tl-org {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.tl-period {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .65rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  margin-left: auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.tl-role {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: .82rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--accent);
  margin-bottom: .5rem;
}
.tl-desc {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   CERT / SKILLS CHIPS
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.chip-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
.chip {

/* ══════════════════════════════════════

.footer-strip {

<h2 class="section-title">&#128100; About Me</h2>
<div class="bio-panel">
  <p>
    I am a Master of IT in Business (Digital Transformation) candidate at Singapore Management University,
    with a background that bridges supply chain operations and data-driven decision-making. Before joining SMU,
    I spent several years managing procurement and logistics in Vietnam, where I developed a hands-on appreciation
    for how good data visualisation can cut through operational noise and drive meaningful action.
  </p>
  <p>
    My journey into analytics began not in a classroom, but on the warehouse floor — building Excel models to
    track inventory, negotiating supplier contracts, and eventually integrating generative AI into reporting
    workflows. That practical foundation now informs how I approach every visualisation project in ISSS608:
    the goal is not a pretty chart, but a decision made with greater confidence.
  </p>
  <p>
    Outside of coursework, I am currently interning at Singtel, where I work at the intersection of AI adoption,
    learning &amp; development, and organisational transformation — helping teams understand and embed AI into
    their daily workflows.
  </p>
</div>
